content_sections.heading: DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 18 vacancies are available - 1 for Dental Surgeon and 17 for Health Inspector Grade II.

content_sections.heading: DHS Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: BDS / MDS Registered in Tamil Nadu Dental Council. Must have passed 12th with Biology / Botany and Zoology. Must have passed the Tamil language as a subject in SSLC level. Must possess two Years for Multi Purpose Health worker (Male) / HI / SI Course training / offered by recognized private Institution / Trust / Universities / Deemed Universities including Gandhi gram Rural Institute training Course Certificate granted by the DPH& PM.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Thanjavur Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https:/ / thanjavur.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Thanjavur Dental Surgeon recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Dental Surgeon posts in the District Health Society Thanjavur is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Dental Surgeon post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Dental Surgeon position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Dental Surgeon post, candidates must possess a BDS or MDS degree and be registered with the Tamil Nadu Dental Council.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Dental Surgeon post?
faq.answer: The District Health Society Thanjavur has announced a total of 18 vacancies for the Dental Surgeon position. However, the detailed breakdown shows 1 vacancy per post in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DHS Thanjavur Dental Surgeon recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and submit it either in person or by post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for the Dental Surgeon recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Dental Surgeon positions are offered on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Health Society Thanjavur, which is https://thanjavur.nic.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of all required certificates, including educational qualifications, registration, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.
